owner_authority.earlier_owner_decision: use GPT 6 through the consumer selector label Latest

assistant_response_binding.binding_rule: Browser controller must bind this directive to the actual assistant data-message-id and SHA-256 of the exact visible response bytes after completion. Codex must reject any later transcription lacking those externally captured values.

preservation_method: Before modifying J3 capture/finalization code, assert the verified baseline branch and exact local/GitHub HEAD.
Recursively enumerate the complete existing Sol J3 tree structurally only.

Create a deterministic inventory containing relative path, entry type, byte size where applicable, permission mode, and SHA-256 for every regular file; hashing bytes is permitted but semantic inspection is not.
Record directory entries and modes so the tree can be reconstructed exactly.

Verify that the structural state agrees with 23 valid judgments, zero failures, haltedClaim null, the supplied J3 progress SHA-256, the supplied ordinal-23 receipt SHA-256, and absence of any staged/sent ordinal-24 attempt.
Copy or atomically relocate the complete tree into a clearly superseded private-audit namespace without modifying source bytes.
Set every preserved regular file containing run evidence or manifests to mode 0600 and every containing audit directory to mode 0700.
Re-hash the preserved copy and require exact equality with the pre-preservation inventory before proceeding.
Persist the deterministic inventory and its own SHA-256 beside the preserved tree under the same protections.

phase_2_update_harness.purpose: Remove Sol-specific execution provenance constraints while preserving evaluator semantics.
required_changes: Remove or supersede the J3 execution requirement that forces selector/model GPT-5.6 Sol.
Remove or supersede the capture-helper requirement that forces GPT-5.6 Sol, Extra High, or provider slug gpt-5-6-thinking.
Do not alter evaluator packet bytes.
Do not alter the judgment payload/schema or any matching, adjudication, metric, retry, frozen-schedule, or sealed-condition-map behavior.
Make finalizer series identity explicit and require one homogeneous complete Latest series.
repository_control: Baseline mutation is authorized only after asserting branch task/mast-four-arm-zero-spend-harness-20260901 and local==GitHub HEAD==777b3b37cd619944340e9164cc1c536bfd2671f9.
Run focused tests for preservation, provenance capture, homogeneous-series enforcement, retry identity, finalizer series selection, checkpoint recovery, and sealed-state non-access.
Before any evaluator send, require local HEAD equals the corresponding GitHub branch HEAD and record that execution commit in structural run provenance.

reasoning_setting.rule: Use the selected model's highest authorized reasoning setting actually exposed and observed in the consumer UI at send time.

latest_series.restart_rule: No prior Sol judgment counts toward any Latest slot.

checks: Local HEAD exactly equals GitHub branch HEAD.
Run provenance is bound to the current execution commit.
Target ordinal belongs to the unchanged frozen 41-slot schedule.
Highest authorized reasoning setting currently exposed in the UI is selected and its exact visible label is captured.
Signed-in consumer account has not changed.
Exactly one reusable physical evaluator tab is being used.
Attempt starts in a fresh conversation.
Packet SHA-256 matches the frozen packet expected for that slot and retry attempts are byte-identical.
No Sol output has been copied, transformed, imported, or reused as the judgment.
No clinical response content or result has been inspected.
No paid API path is active.

must_pass_before_slot_1: Superseded Sol tree is recoverably preserved and reverified against its deterministic inventory.
Latest provenance can be captured without a provider slug.
Finalizer ignores superseded Sol judgments for Latest completion.
Retry path preserves exact packet bytes and the four-attempt mechanical ceiling.

checkpoint_requirements: Record valid Latest count and next ordinal.
Record execution commit and homogeneous series identity.
Do not aggregate, interpret, unblind, or inspect judgment meaning.

required_acceptance: Exactly 41 valid Latest judgments exist for the unchanged frozen 41-slot schedule.
Every slot has exactly one accepted Latest judgment.
Every accepted receipt names selector label Latest.
Every accepted receipt records the actually observed highest authorized UI reasoning label.
No receipt invents a provider model slug.
No accepted Latest judgment originates from or reuses a preserved Sol output.
All structural hashes and checkpoint chain validations pass.
Condition map remains sealed until whatever pre-existing authorized finalization boundary already governs it; this directive creates no new access authority.

absolute_prohibitions: Do not finalize from mixed Sol and Latest judgments.
Do not count, copy, transform, paraphrase, import, or otherwise reuse any prior Sol evaluator output as a Latest judgment.
Do not inspect, infer, summarize, classify, interpret, or expose clinical response content.
Do not inspect or infer rubric meaning, condition mapping, arms, families, judgments, metrics, or results.
Do not tune packets, prompts, matching, adjudication, metrics, schedule, or retry behavior.
Do not apply any continuation gate.
Do not switch the signed-in consumer account.
Do not use a paid API.
Do not guess a provider model slug.
Do not invent the unavailable current owner message ID.
Do not mutate the primary series.
Do not send ordinal 24 as a continuation of the superseded Sol series.
Do not start the Latest series anywhere except ordinal 1.

execution_verdict: AUTHORIZED: preserve the complete 23-judgment Sol J3 tree as superseded private audit evidence, adapt only execution/provenance plumbing, then restart J3 from ordinal 1 for a new homogeneous 41-slot consumer-selector Latest series. Fail closed on any provenance, preservation, structural-verification, account, packet-identity, or series-homogeneity violation.
